purpose: Classify runtime PNGs so test screenshots, reference images, and temporary placeholders are not treated as final commercial art.
notes: Files under tmp/ are QA screenshots, intermediate crops, contact sheets, or visual comparison artifacts. They must never be referenced by runtime code.
Files under assets/textures/references/ are full-page design references. They are development-only and must never be packaged as runtime art.
runtimePlaceholder assets are allowed to keep the preview playable, but they are not final commercial UI art.
temporaryAlias assets, if present, are valid files temporarily reused for a different product-level key and should be replaced before release.
